question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
SELECT sp.page_id, sp.page_name, sp.product_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER as views,
       SUM(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER as added_to_cart,
       (SUM(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::INTEGER as left_in_cart,
       SUM(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INTEGER as purchases
FROM shopping_cart_events se
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy sp ON se.page_id = sp.page_id
WHERE se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY sp.page_id, sp.page_name, sp.product_id
ORDER BY sp.product_id
